name: Anime Hot Resort
source:
Anime Hot Resort is an immersive adult visual novel set in a luxurious tropical resort, where beloved anime characters converge for the vacation of a lifetime. 

As the newest staff member at this exclusive hideaway, you’ll find yourself surrounded by familiar faces in unusual situations. Your task? To charm, flirt, and explore intimate encounters with these iconic characters, all while enjoying the resort’s scenic beauty and relaxing vibes. Dive into the resort now, and let the seduction begin! 

[From [url=https://naughty-narratives.itch.io/anime-hot-resort]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《动漫热门度假村》是一部身临其境的成人视觉小说，背景设定在豪华的热带度假村，深受喜爱的动漫角色聚集在一起，度过一生难忘的假期。

作为这个独特的世外桃源的最新员工，你会发现自己在不寻常的情况下被熟悉的面孔包围。你的任务？与这些标志性人物进行魅力、调情和探索亲密接触，同时享受度假村的美景和轻松的氛围。现在就潜入度假村，让诱惑开始吧！

[来自[url=https://naughty-narratives.itch.io/anime-hot-resort]itch.io[/url]]
